technology_name: STEEL PLATED GROOVED BOX SECTION (SPGBS) ANCHORAGE SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ENHANCING RAILWAY SLEEPER STABILITY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Ballasted railway track sleepers experience lateral alignment shifting and ballast migration under high-speed dynamic train braking forces, creating high derailment hazards.
description: A heavy-duty track stabilizing assembly comprising a steel-plated grooved box section ($SPGBS$) anchor layout configured to bolt detachably to both terminal sides of concrete sleepers, providing a high cross-sectional area to disperse stress and resist ballast movement.
applications: High-speed passenger rail tracks, heavy industrial bulk cargo rail networks, urban metro track curves, and narrow-to-broad gauge railway structural updates.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Robotics, Automation & Drones
